title: Annotatio V §.IV: Else no catholic Christian consensus or Catholic Church — vain hymn of all Christendom
pass_a_gloss: Otherwise there will never be given any catholic Consensus of Christians, nor any Catholic Church coupled by that consensus — so that we would both believe this Church in vain and sing falsely of that consensus: “All Christendom on earth holds quite evenly in one mind.”
pass_b_english: Otherwise there will never be any catholic Christian consensus, nor any Catholic Church joined by that consensus.
Then we would believe that Church in vain, and sing falsely: “All Christendom on earth holds quite evenly in one mind.”
source_text: Secus, nec dabitur Consensus Christianorum catholicus ullus unquam, nec ulla Ecclesia Catholica, consensu istô copulata, ut & hanc frustra credamus & de istô mendaciter cantillemus: Die ganze Christenheit auf Erden / hält in einem Sinn gar eben.
notes: Without that: no catholic consensus/Church; German hymn.
